notes.title: Service Closure and Maintenance Announcement
notes.notes:
Hello, this is the Ironsight team.

First of all, we would like to sincerely thank all the users who have loved and supported Ironsight over the years.
After much consideration, we regret to inform you that the Ironsight service will be coming to an end as of August 6th, 2025.
The time we've spent with all of you has been incredibly precious, and it is with a very heavy heart and deep regret that we share this decision.

Since starting the service via Steam in 2019, six years have passed.
Although there were many shortcomings, it was thanks to the love and support of our users that we were able to continue the service up until now.

[h3][b]Service End Schedule[/b][/h3][list]

[b]W Coin Sale Suspension:[/b] May 9, 2025 (following maintenance)
[b]Official Service Closure:[/b] August 6, 2025, at 15:00 (GMT +9) [/list]

We would like to express our deepest gratitude once again to all the users who have been with Ironsight, and we sincerely hope to be able to greet you again in the future with something even better.

Thank you,
Sincerely,
The Ironsight Team

Whether you're blasting through the competition, honing your skills, or trying to complete all of the event challenges, it's bound to be a blast (literally).

But that’s not all—we’re also kicking off this year’s Black Friday Sales and Event! Get ready for unbeatable deals and returning challenges with exclusive seasonal rewards to earn.

notes.title: Season 16 Update : Hidden Depths
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35212832/8596d6c87e782a6536d1d2efa8563b1dcf849b91.png[/img]

Once a serene paradise boasting beautiful natural landscapes, Island is now a desolate ruin unrecognizable from it's past. Originally known for its lush forests and pristine beaches, the island’s fate changed when EDEN established its roots there. Deep beneath the island, EDEN constructed a secret base to experiment with 'Dark Trinitium', a legendary energy source believed to be magnitudes more powerful than it's predecessor, granting unlimited power to those who are able to harness it's full potential. 

Amidst the chaos of rampant AI and aging electric power systems, the world faced a severe energy crisis. Seizing this opportunity, EDEN aimed to secretly produce Dark Trinitium to reshape the world, but in a bid to thwart EDEN's ambitions, the NAF stepped in, determined to halt their plans.

[h2]Season 15 Ranked Leaderboard Reset[/h2]
It has come to our attention that a significant bug has affected the integrity of thr Season 15 ranked leaderboards. This bug inadvertently allowed users to gain ranked points at an accelerated rate, undermining the fairness and competitive spirit of the ranked leaderboards. After thorough investigation and deliberation, we have made the difficult decision to reset the leaderboards for Season 15 ranked and duel to ensure the integrity of the season. The leaderboards will be reset with maintenance on March 20.

We recognize the frustration and disappointment this may cause to the users who participated in ranked matches over the past week, and we want to express our sincerest apologies for the inconvenience. We are committed to maintaining a fair and competitive playing field for all our players, and this reset is a necessary step to address the current issue and ensure the competition of Season 15 is fair for everyone.

To express our sincere apologies and in recognition of the disruption this decision brings, we will be hosting an XP/GP Boost Event this weekend, starting on Saturday 23rd of March at 10AM (KST) and ending on Monday the 25th of March at 10AM (KST).

Once again we are truly sorry for any inconvenience this has caused. Thank you for your continued support and understanding.

notes.title: Season 14 Update : Unidentified
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35212832/7456ca0dbdc2daf08f60e4f77f9e844507912eaa.jpg[/img]

Hello everyone, this is the Ironsight Team.

The Unidentified Task Force (UTF) are in charge of investigating unidentified incidents from around the world. These events take many forms, including UAP's, paranormal phenomena, and the discovery of strange and other-worldly life forms. The UTF is made up of individuals who possess the special capabilities required to solve such incidents, and they strive to track and uncover the truth behind all unidentified cases.

During their investigations, the UTF have begun to approach a powerful covert syndicate that may just be behind the unidentified incidents.

notes.title: Season 13 Update : Shadow Strike
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35212832/7e42a200a6b368c103cbc41282fc8838ce2b4ad0.png[/img]

Hello everyone, this is the Ironsight Team.

A group of hackers are planning to use the 'Protocol' for a ruthless terrorist attack. Upon learning of this fact, Man'n'Tech has urgently dispatched mercenaries to thwart the hackers and their plan. France, upon receiving intelligence that the protocol signal was detected in an underground bunker within its territory, faces a direct threat to national security.

In response, France assigns the special forces unit GIGN with an operation, code-named "Shadow Strike", to retrieve the protocol and prevent the terrorist plot.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35212832/80b4fd32aa43b8c04f743701e2624142985cd631.jpg[/img]


[h3][b]Secondary Weapon Attachments[/b][/h3]
Secondary weapon attachments have finally arrived. Modify the performance of your secondary weapon by fitting it with a variety of different attachments. To start with, Pistols can be equipped with silencers, scopes, tactical lasers, extended magazines, charms, and bullets, with various other parts planned to be added in the future.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35212832/14e878d0746f13f0534370620297970747a0c4db.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35212832/8df719a93d9d9615410fb21a1a35495ab1e4434a.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35212832/cdeae8435d0efe1f1303dedb51879c60b84fd82b.jpg[/img]



[h3][b]Skin Renewal[/b][/h3]
Gold, Rose Gold, Chrome, and Aquamarine skins have been modified to now have their material/color cover the entire weapon rather than certain parts, making them more extravagant than ever!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35212832/efb4764351194f6bec874fb2b5f1bf9ee85c0b1b.png[/img]

[h3][b]Weapon Durability Removal[/b][/h3]
The development team has recently been working on removing inconvenient systems that are present in the game. The removal of the weapon durability system has been a frequent request from players for a while now, and although it is a bit late we are happy to announce that durability is being removed from the game. With it's removal, the durability for weapons will no longer degrade, and players will no longer have to worry about repairing their weapons. Instead, GP can now be used on skins and other things that are more important.

[h3][b]Reduced Secondary Weapon Experience Requirements[/b][/h3]
There has been a lot of feedback regarding Secondary Weapon levelling, and how the required experience needed to level up is the same as primary weapons despite secondaries being used in less situations. As a result we have decided to reduce the experience needed to level up for all secondary weapons by 30%.

[h3][b]Log-in Rewards[/b][/h3]
The daily rewards have been refreshed. Check the calendar in-game for more details.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35212832/96114ec48fd1c8d22cee1f6f9c4fd121434f0c9e.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]Ranked Match[/b][/h3]
A new season of Ranked will start with the release of Season 13, featuring an updated pool of maps.
All rewards from Ranked Season 12 will be delivered with the release of Season 13.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35212832/0d0ea51b2192073f90706298a74b211d0618b70d.jpg[/img]

The leaderboards have also been updated to allow users to view the leaderboards of past seasons. Now you can check what rank you were in previous seasons, and aim for a higher rank in the next one!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35212832/586227d0f5bafe283458015561fe2cf58b823d64.jpg[/img]

[*] [Game Mode] Frontline has been removed from Quickplay, and it's daily mission has also been removed.
[*] [Sound] Sound effects have been added to indicate when your microphone is activated.[/*]

Hello everyone this is the Ironsight Team.

Season 12 is launching on April 26 and will be active for 85 days, ending on the 19th of July.

As Man’n’Tech attempt to control rumors regarding the existence of an ‘Unknown Protocol’, hacker groups have taken the opportunity to become key players in the ongoing war. 

Season 12 brings a plethora of new content for everyone to enjoy. Master the new Uzi submachine gun and E-Tool melee weapon, use the new hacker skill to take control of enemy drones, battle in the new Paloo map, and unlock the spectacular Nebula Skins for secondary weapons.

notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35212832/9ef00bb5f13e5ac1189d427559f37d17e5659a06.png[/img]

Season 12 has almost arrived. Let's take a look at what the new Season entails, and the story behind the Unknown Protocol.

"Intelligence has been gathered, stating that a key technician at Man'n'Tech has been assassinated. The murder is believed to be connected to the 'Unknown Protocol', which the technician had preemptively installed fearing that their technology may be used to one day carry out atrocities. It is suspected that Man'n'Tech became aware of this Unknown Protocol, and hired troubleshooters to resolve the issue. When hacker's became aware of this Unknown Protocol and it's possibility for creating vulnerabilities in the system, they starting hacking into the system in order to change the course of the war."

Hello everyone, this is the Ironsight Team.

This week’s update contains exciting new features for everyone!

Firstly, a new ranked event mode ‘Crossbow Team Death Match’ will be available.
The crossbow is a highly challenging weapon that requires precise aiming and careful shooting with each shot. Improve your crossbow weapon proficiency with Event Mode and climb the event leaderboard.

A new silencer attachment has been added to sniper rifles.
The sniper rifle silencer attachment is one of the features that many players have been looking forward to. The silencer attachment will be able to provide more play styles for sniper rifle players who have been unable to hide their location when firing. However, you must caution because only a limited number of attachments can be used.

A new G&S Sarah package has been added to the store.
The G&S Sara Package is a limited package that you can purchase per account. Once you purchase, you can acquire the attractive G&S Sarah character, G&S AKS-74U weapon skin, G&S silencer skin, and a cute emblem.

The crossbow is one of powerful secondary weapons, capable of silently killing an enemy with a single shot. However, it is a weapon that requires such high proficiency that a single disturbance can make it difficult to use properly.

notes.title: 2022 Year Review and Updated Road Map
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35212832/06b0da4803f3d044e51efe200042ad51594319ad.jpg[/img]

2022 has come to a close and it is time again to look at everything we have accomplished throughout the year, as well as everything we have planned going forward!

[h1]2022 in Review[/h1]
2022 was an amazing year and we are very grateful for all of our users. In 2022 Ironsight saw a lot of new faces with 700,000 new accounts being registered throughout the year, and in total we played almost 5,200,000 rounds together.

Ironsight is never short on weapon variety, and in 2022 6 new weapons were added to Ironsights arsenal with 3 new guns (M5i, UMP45 and RM277) and 3 new melee weapons (Kukri, Skeleton Knife, Stiletto) for everyone to use on the battlefield.

[h2]Events[/h2]
We had a lot of fun this year with our regular seasonal events (Spring, Summer, Halloween, Winter), with upgraded event challenges, rewards, and cosmetics. 
[previewyoutube=3zxxESwlW5g;full][/previewyoutube]
In addition we also saw the introduction of new Ranked Event Modes (Sniper Match, Rocket Battle, Pistol Secure Point) which allow everyone to experience Ironsight in a new way and hone their skills with specific weapons and rules. With individual leaderboards and special ranked rewards, we can't wait to see what new modes will be available in the new year!

[h2]User Suggestions[/h2]
Our community has never shown a lack of ideas, suggestions, feedback, and constructive criticism regarding the game and it’s potential. We are always scouring the community channels to see what kind of content or improvements the community wants, and we are very pleased with all of the new additions in 2022 that came from user suggestions. Just to name a few:[list]
[*]Voice Chat
[*]Server Selection options for both Custom and Matchmaking games
[*]Party separation options to enable parties of up to 5
[*]Adding FFA Mode to Quick Play
[*]Making the Training M4 an ownable gun that can be equipped at will
[*]Daily Store [/list]

These are just some of the ideas that came from our wonderful community. For those who are not yet a part of our Discord, it is a great place to talk with other fans of the game, get the latest updates, post your own suggestions, and get in touch with members of the Ironsight Team. Follow the link below to join! 

[url=discord.gg/Ironsight]Join our Discord!
[/url]
[h2]Major Updates[/h2]
2022 was home to 3 major updates, leading up to the newly released Season 11.

[h3]Season 8: Space Force[/h3]
The Space Force update saw the release of the first Drone Skins which allowed users to call in drones with a bit more style! It also introduced the heavily requested skill ‘Ammo Supply’, giving users the ability to resupply whilst they are on a killing spree!
[previewyoutube=ao2x36hg2mU;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]Season 9: MiliTech[/h3]
The MiliTech update introduced the brand new Robot Custom Character which is able to be customized with various parts that can be earned through achievements or purchased directly. A new ‘Stealth’ skill was added to shield users from the enemies intelligence gathering drones, and the Cheek Pad attachment for Sniper Rifles was also added.
Last but definitely not least, Resource Takeover mode finally made a return after being inactive for some time. We were so happy to be able to bring back this massively requested mode!
[previewyoutube=SuYMyC0MQm0;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]Season 10: Treasure Hunter[/h3]
The final major update for 2022, Treasure Hunter came with perhaps the communities most requested feature, unlockable ‘Nebula’ skins for max level weapons! The lobby was also updated so that party members can see each other and show off their loadouts before joining a match, and Ranked Season 10 included a brand new Ranked Box daily reward which contains a brand new and solo ranked exclusive weapon camo: Aquamarine.
[previewyoutube=OKq1j2Ycw5s;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]The Future of Ironsight[/h1]
We have a lot of ideas lined up for the new year, and we would like to share them with you. We have also setup an online Roadmap so that users can keep track of what updates are planned, in development, and completed. This is not a definitive schedule, and there may be some extra surprises along the way that aren’t outlined in the Roadmap, but we will try to keep it as up-to-date as possible!

You can view Ironsights roadmap by [url=https://wiplegames.notion.site/56e2b682580042e6b4751acccd4aadc4?v=754012f6dc694a4db6f0a5e691013f48]clicking this link[/url] and you can read more detailed information about our plans for the future below.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35212832/1d5943dc2164e773324a19bed81a45c61ff1e404.png[/img]

[h2]Events and Updates[/h2]
We plan to continue the schedule of Season Themed Events (Winter, Summer, etc) and hope to make this year’s iterations even more fun, challenging, and rewarding! We also plan to continue releasing major updates via seasons, starting off with the Season 11 update which was released this week! Event Modes will also continue to be introduced, including examples such as Crossbows Only, Knives Only, and Shotguns Only.

[h2]Sandbox Features and Maps[/h2]
In the future we aim to provide more sandbox features for the community to play with, enjoy, and show off their creativity and imagination. For example, a map creation tool that would give users a simple way to create, share, and play on custom maps. We will also be updating current maps with new and improved lighting, and fixing map glitches, exploits and defects.

[h2]Clan Improvements[/h2]
Strengthening the social aspect of Ironsight, and in particular the Clan environment, is something the team is looking into for 2023. Although we do not have any specifics to share at the moment, this could include strengthening clan rewards, improving Clan Wars, the introduction of a clan lobby or village-type feature, and a clan store. 

[h2]Weapons[/h2]
Throughout the year we plan on continuing to release new Primary, Secondary, and Melee weapons, as well as adjusting those that have already been released to continually refresh the meta. Additionally, Lethal / Tactical equipment may receive some new special effects, models, and color variations, with some brand new pieces of equipment as well.

[h2]Skills/Attachments[/h2]
The team is excited to add more skills and attachments throughout the year. This includes secondary attachments which were planned for last year but unfortunately were not ready in time. Don’t worry though, they are definitely still coming! Additionally, Sniper Rifle silencers and various other new gadgets to modify your weapons performance are in development so keep an eye out for them in the new year.

[h2]Twitch Drops[/h2]
We are always grateful to all of the people who create content and share Ironsight with other people. We hope to implement Twitch Drops to help the Ironsight Twitch community grow and give users new ways to earn rewards!

[h2]Performance and Reliability[/h2]
Our team will continue to upgrade server reliability and performance, ensure that EAC and our anti-cheating protocols are cutting edge and working efficiently, and continue efforts on improving the netcode and solving any netcode related issues.

[h2]Community Engagement[/h2]
We will continue to collaborate with the community and make improvements to the game with the help of everyone's input! Thank you to everyone who takes the time to send us suggestions and feedback about the game.
We will also strive to further community engagement and reach in 2023 with continued events, competitions and contests, as well as increasing efforts in promotion and marketing to bring Ironsight to a wider audience.

[h2]Much, Much More![/h2]
This is just scratching the surface for what we have planned so far! We also plan to introduce more loadout slots, the ability to practice in the gun range whilst searching for a match, improved replay functionality, Steam Deck support, animated Titles, Emblems, and Dog Tags, Sprays, more Challenges, Drones, PvE Modes, and more! 

We look forward to sharing all of these new updates with you in the future.
From everyone here at the Ironsight Team, thank you!

Hello everyone this is the Ironsight Team.

Season 11 is launching on January 11 and will be live for 85 days, ending on the 5th of April.

As the war between factions goes on, the threat of CBRN warfare intensifies. Prepare yourself with the Season 11 Battle Pass which includes new armor that has looks to be specifically designed to deal with harmful chemicals. Handle the Battle Pass with care however, as some of the items included look incredibly toxic themselves!

Equip yourself for maximum efficiency in medium and close-ranged combat with this season’s newest additions: the AKS-74U and the M1887 shotgun.

Daily Missions have been upgraded, with improved rewards and new missions to achieve every day. A new PvE Mission, Demolition, has also been added, and the newest season of Ranked is set to begin as soon as the update goes live.

[h3][b]Ranked Mode Changes[/b][/h3]

We have received a lot of feedback regarding Search and Destroy Hardcore following the start of the new ranked season. After conducting a survey it has been shown that the majority of users would rather Search and Destroy Classic instead of the Hardcore variant. As a result, the team has decided to change the game mode for Solo Ranked to Search and Destroy Classic, starting with this week’s update on the 16th.

The change of mode will have the following effects, with all other rules remaining as they were.[list]
[*]Ranked Mode Change : Search and Destroy Hardcore → Search and Destroy Classic
[*]Friendly Fire is disabled
[*]Team Revival is disabled
[*]Each players ranked rating will remain unchanged

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35212832/de7f69eaafda48e741bbb10879c1cf5cb7f364f0.jpg[/img]

Gather your friends and meetup in Ironsight. It’s time to take a group photo! 

Sometimes it is all too easy to get caught up in the competition and grind. Let’s pause and take a moment to enjoy the friends we have, and the time we get to spend together! Take a screenshot with your friends in Ironsight, create a memory, and win some prizes!

[h2]How to Participate[/h2][list]
[h3]Taking a screenshot in Ironsight[/h3][list]
Take your screenshot in Ironsight using the [Print Screen] key. Screenshots are automatically saved to the screenshots folder in your Ironsight directory: [list]

C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Ironsight_wpg\screenshots[/list]
Screenshots can be taken as a spectator, in first person, or in a replay. The only rule is that they are taken within the game! Be as creative as possible and make sure your screenshot stands out from all the other entrants! (And don’t forget to maximize your video option settings to ensure the screenshot is taken with the best quality!)
[i][b]Tip: Use Alt + U to remove the HUD and take prettier screenshots![/b][/i]
[/list]

After taking a screenshot in-game with your friends, upload it to the [b]#screenshots channel[/b] in [url=discord.gg/ironsight]Ironsight’s Official Discord[/url] with the tag [b]#screenshotcontest[/b].

When making a submission, please be sure to include the following information:[list]
[*] The callsign of every user who is present in the screenshot (Including the cameraman!)
[*] Attach the tag `#screenshotcontest` to the message
[/list]
[i]Note: please make sure that all included callsigns are typed accurately, otherwise the user may not be eligible for a prize.[/i]
[/list]

[h2]Schedule[/h2][list]
[u][b]Submission Period[/b][/u][list]
November 7 - November 21 10:00 (GMT +9)

November 22

November 22 ~ November 28

[u][b]Reward Delivery[/b][/u][list]
November 29

notes.title: 11.09 Update & Ranked Season 10
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35212832/e621d33855e374a22c8a5501bfae48b83c4b09eb.png[/img]

Ranked Season 10 is about to begin.

Like Season 9, Season 10 will continue with the format of Ranked [Solo], with 2 teams of 5 players coming together to battle for Ranked Points. Search and Destroy Classic will be the featured game mode this season, and a new Ranked Match Supply Box has been added as a daily challenge reward!

Furthermore, a new system has been introduced which carries over users’ ranked score from the previous season if it was more than 1200. (If a players score was less than 1200, it will be reset to 1200) 

Read more details about the new season below.

Server maintenance will take place on Wednesday, November 9th.
Please make sure to disconnect from the servers in advance in order to avoid any issues.

[b]Maintenance Schedule:
[/b]
[KST] 14:00 ~ 16:00 November 9th
[CEST] 06:00 ~ 08:00 November 9th
[PDT] 22:00 ~ 24:00 November 8th



[h2][b]Ranked Match[/b][/h2]
[list]
[h3][b]Season 10 Ranked [Solo][/b][/h3][list]

[*][b]Schedule[/b] : November 9 - December 14 (36 Days)
[*][b]Parties[/b] : Disabled
[*][b]Mode[/b] : Search and Destroy Classic
[*][b]Team Size[/b] : 5 vs 5 
[*][b]Map List[/b] 13 Total [Same list as previous season]
[*][b]Open Time[/b] : 24/7
[*][b]Level Requirement[/b] : You must be level 25 in order to participate (Down from 30)
[*] Maximum earnable ranked score through placement matches is limited
[*][b]Streak Bonuses[/b] : 
- Win Streak Bonuses exist, stacking up to a maximum of 3 times
- Loss Streak Penalties do not exist
[*][b]Penalties[/b] :
- Inactivity penalty after 7 days.
- Abandoning a game will result in a temporary restriction in joining ranked matches again. This time will increase for repeat offences.
-  Leaving a game early will count as a loss.
[/list]

Clan Wars and Duel will remain in the pre-season. These modes will still give XP and progress Daily Missions, but there will not be any Ranked Rewards for their leaderboards.


[h3][b]Daily Rewards[/b][/h3][list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35212832/38210dbd7481c02a7842cde8bcc28572ea8f1ec4.png[/img]
Participate in Ranked matches everyday to earn rewards
[/list]


[h3][b]Season 10 Rewards[/b][/h3][list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35212832/7df92161818634fff4ef6be6d731ef0acaf364bb.png[/img]
Complete the Daily Ranked Misisons everyday and earn a Ranked Match Supply Box 
More details about the Season 10 Rewards will be announced at a later date.[/list]

[h3][b]Ranked Rules[/b][/h3][list]

Users that partake in actions that violate basic game rules will automatically be excluded from receiving any rewards. This includes the use of glitches, bugs, map boosting, use of 3rd party programs and hacks, etc.

Such users will have their Season rating removed and will be suspended from the games services.

[b][u]Punishable Activities[/u][/b][list]
[*]Account sharing (For example, letting someone else play on your account in order to achieve a higher rank)
[*]Refusing to participate in the game, or going AFK.
[*]Intentionally losing or throwing the game.
[*]Alerting the enemy of you or your teammates position, or other information
[*][The following rules apply to Clan Wars][list]
[*]Moving to another clan with the intent/purpose of playing against your original clan.
[*]Using alternate accounts under one clan in order to raise the score of another clan that you belong to.
[*]Clans collaborating with each other in order to avoid other clans, and only match with each other.[/list][/list][/list][/list]


[h2][b]Bug Fixes and Improvements[/b][/h2][list]

[*][b][Map][/b] Rust has been removed from the Secure Point map pool 
[*][b][Female Custom Character][/b] The Female Custom Character model and it's Custom parts have been modified to address a defect in the animations.
[*][b][Options/Video][/b] Added an option to adjust the FPS Cap in the lobby.
[*][b][Options/Video][/b] Added the option to choose between visually holding the weapon in your right or left hand. However, some text may not be mirrored correctly. To resolve this, additional textures would have to be used, and since this would waste resources the issue has not been remedied.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35212832/48f529aa099d1e9d07826b6da399037cc5cb75b3.jpg[/img]
[*][b][Weapon Animations][/b] Special animations have been added to the Pink Killer AUG A3, Pink Killer MP5 A5, and Pink Killer M4 ACC-M.
[*][b][Loadout][/b] Items are now sorted alphabetically. (However, some items will still appear at the top of the list due to grade, being a recent purchase, etc)
[*][b][Daily Missions][/b] Daily mission reset time has been changed to 13:00 GMT +9 so that it happens during a less active time. Furthermore, time remaining until reset will now be displayed.
[*][b][Shaders][/b] Fixed an error that occurred with certain settings that made the outline shader on attachments and the HUD appear opaque.
[*][b][Particle Effects][/b] Reduced and removed some of the particle effects (explosion, smoke) that occurred when a robot was killed.
[*][b][Reticle][/b] Fixed an issue with the reticle’s positioning when transitioning between ADS and hipfire.
[*][b][Parkour][/b] When jumping through a window, you must press Forward + Jump at the same time to jump through it.
[*][b][Drone][/b] Escort Drone Balance Adjustments
- Minimum Damage : Reduced from 8 → 5
- Attack Speed: Reduced by 10%
- Added the following text to the drones description: "Attack/Detection Range 25m". Also, the Drones attack will be cancelled if the distance to the target surpasses the maximum range.
[*][b][Replays][/b] Each client can now store up to 99 replays
[*][b][Replays][/b] Due to internal code changes, any replays that were saved before the update will no longer be viewable 
[*]Client Stability and Optimization[/list]
[Added November 06][list]
[*]Corrected a bug that allowed players who were close to bulletproof glass to be attacked from the other side.
[*][b][Troll Protection][/b] Killing a teammate in Search and Destroy Hardcore mode will cause you to take damage.
[/list]
[Added November 08][list]
[*]Fixed an issue that caused Sniper Scopes to 'jump' when zooming in.
[/list]
[Added November 10][list]
[*][b][Search and Destroy Hardcore][/b] Fixed an issue that caused the Claymore to be triggered by allies.
[*][b][Search and Destroy Hardcore][/b] Fixed an issue with player animations not correctly transitioning to the downed state in replays.
[/list]

* The final update is subject to change following testing and feedback

notes.title: 09.08 Update & Chuseok Event
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35212832/38e2a580ea7e77931432898b6fbcad362234687e.png[/img]

Hello everyone, this is the Ironsight team.

This update introduces one of the features that have been frequently requested by the community recently.

Until now, during matchmaking, the server has been selected automatically to ensure the lowest possible ping for the majority of players in the lobby. Unfortunately however, this sometimes forces an outlying user to play on a server that is suboptimal. Although there may be more suitable servers available, a user can be forced into high ping servers if the pool of users available is concentrated in a specific region.

There have been many requests to divide the SEA and Asia regions, but before the merging of the servers last year in July, there were a lot of reports regarding long queue times and issues with matchmaking. As such, it has been judged that re-dividing the regions would not be feasible with the current number of users.

Alternatively, in order to help alleviate the issue we have decided to provide users the option to select which servers to connect to when matchmaking. As long as the user pool is sufficient, this will allow users to play on the servers that provide the best experience for them.

There are some concerns that this may reduce the number of possible users in the matchmaking pool, but we hope it will improve the overall game experience for all users.

In addition to this weeks maintenance, a special event will also be held this weekend, so continue reading to learn more about the new matchmaking options, special event, and the closing of Season 9!

Server maintenance will take place on Thursday, September 8th.
Please make sure to disconnect from the servers in advance in order to avoid any issues.

notes.title: 07.28 Maintenance
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35212832/4b806df3be0491a633d221fcc7386e851a661056.png[/img]

Hello everyone, this is the Ironsight Team

Following this update, in Team Sniper Match, parties may now be split onto different teams according to team balance. 

Ironsight’s Matching Pool (The amount of players looking for a match at the same time) is continuing to have difficulties with creating even teams. As matching players with only other players with similar skill levels can increase the waiting time significantly, we often have to match players of different skils together. However this can sometimes cause teams to be out of balance, and along with the existence of parties of significantly high or low skill, can further worsen team balance.

To solve this problem, we have changed the way parties are handled in Team Sniper Match so that the teams can be balanced more equally and the battle can be more enjoyable. Many people have given us their opinions, and we will continue to review feedback and make adjustments as necessary. Following this update, if the results and feedback are positive, it is possible that this system may be implemented into other game modes, allowing for users to matchmake with larger parties.

Hello everyone this is the Ironsight Team.

[u][b]The Season 9 update is now live![/b][/u]

The Season 9 Battle Pass includes high-tech weapons, drones, and robots that have been manufactured and produced by MiliTech.

Among them are the new, next-generation custom robots which are controlled manually by mercenary players. This new robot will help to reduce casualties on the battlefield, whilst also proving efficient in battle. Various customization options will also be available at launch.

New weapons will also be released, including the UMP45 and the Skeleton Knife.

The UMP45 is an SMG weapon specializing in effectively overpowering opponents in close-ranged combat. The Skeleton Knife’s light frame allows it to be used swiftly and powerfully whenever the need arises.

Additionally, various unique skins and collection materials for the new Rampage Tar-21 collection weapon are also included in the new Battle Pass. All of these items can be acquired by progressing the Battle Pass.

[previewyoutube=-iGKLaZQ5Y4;full][/previewyoutube][/list]


[h3][b]Battle Pass Details[/b][/h3][list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35212832/f8654e8423008de520f531daadf5449578e777b4.png[/img]
[*]Access the Battle Pass in the bottom right corner of the main lobby screen. Here you can inspect all 100 tiers and check your current progress.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35212832/9a9836a23aef6cf5e47045e43485a261bee69fbf.png[/img]
[*]The Battle Pass can be bought by itself or as part of a bundle package which comes with more tiers already unlocked.
[*]The base Battle Pass comes with 3 tiers unlocked and can be bought for 9,900 W coin, whereas the bundle comes with 20 tiers already unlocked and can be bought for 24,000 W coin.
[*]These tier unlocks are applied to your current progress when buying the Battle Pass. For example, if you are currently on tier 7 when you buy the base Battle Pass, you will unlock 3 tiers and instantly be boosted to tier 10. If you are on tier 20 when you buy the Battle Pass Bundle, you will unlock 20 tiers and instantly be boosted to tier 40.
[*]After buying the Battle Pass, you will have the option to purchase as many tiers as you want using Chips. (Each tier costs 15 Chips)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35212832/eec27169a6a823ba562e1bd4484c2fb364e3f7ee.png[/img]
[*]Each tier costs 15 Chips to unlock.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35212832/fbc00538d43b0e927a4c05847c32a63a15db97a3.png[/img]
[*]You will progress through the Battle Pass as you earn XP in Ironsight. The bar at the bottom of the Battle Pass screen displays your current progress.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35212832/d14e95fcdfa25451144819cb704c9453e0da280e.png[/img]
[*]You can also check your Battle Pass progress at the end of each game on the Match Results screen.
[/list]

[h3][b]Battle Pass FAQ[/b][/h3][list]

[b]Q : How do I activate the Battle Pass??[/b]
A : The free course of the Battle Pass will be automatically activated on all accounts. In order to activate the paid course, you will need to purchase the Battle Pass in-game with W Coins.

[b]Q : What is the difference between free tiers and paid tiers?[/b]
A : The paid course provides rewards for all 100 tiers whereas the free course only provides rewards for select tiers. 

[b]Q : If I purchase the Battle Pass, do I still receive the Free track rewards?[/b]
A : Yes, if you purchase the Battle Pass you will receive the paid rewards as well as the free rewards. 

[b]Q : What happens if I decide to buy the Battle Pass later?[/b]
A : If you already made progress in the Battle Pass before deciding to buy it, all previous paid tier rewards will be unlocked instantly when you purchase the battle pass. 

[b]Q :  Is it possible to continue progressing in the Battle Pass after the season ends?[/b]
A : No, the Battle Pass is only available for a limited time and once the season ends, the Battle Pass will no longer be active and the remaining rewards will no longer be obtainable.

[b]Q : Will I keep the Battle Pass items and be able to use them after the season ends?[/b]
A : Yes, you will be able to keep and use all items that you have earned in the Battle Pass even after the season has concluded. 

[b]Q : Are the items obtainable in the Battle Pass exclusive?[/b]
A : Yes, all items are exclusive to the Battle Pass and cannot be obtained in any other way.

[b]Q : Are there any extra rewards available after obtaining all Battle Pass rewards?[/b]
A : Once you have completed tier 100, there are no extra rewards available.

[b]Q : Do all skins in the Battle Pass come with a special reload animation?[/b]
A : No. Special animations are only available for some skins. If you would like to check if a weapon comes with a special reload animation, please test it out using the gun-range.
[/list]

Hello everyone, this is the Ironsight team.

Season 8 : Space Force will be launching with the March 23rd update.

[b]“As the entire world is strengthening it’s space capabilities and power under the pretense of protecting their space facilities, Man&Tech start work on their Space Defense-2100 project and both NAF and EDEN begin recruiting space defense PMC’s. A new age of information warfare, satellite destruction, space facility protection, space exploration, space resource development and protection is upon us.”[/b]

The Season 8 Battle Pass contains 100 tiers full of cutting-edge equipment of the future. With two new weapons in the form of the RM277 and Stiletto Knife, many new cosmetics items, emotes, unique weapon skins (including one of the required materials for the new Fury AUG collection weapon), and newly introduced drone skins can also be obtained through the Battle Pass this season.

Search and Destroy Hardcore will truly test your skills, as well as your trigger discipline! Using the base Search and Destroy ruleset, many new rules have been added in order to create a truly unique experience. It’s impossible to get yourself back up once you’ve been knocked down so get a teammate to revive you before you bleed out! In accordance with the more unforgiving rules, parties of up to 5 are now allowed, but be careful because with friendly fire now enabled there’s no way of knowing when and where an accident might occur.

The newest skill, Ammo Supply, will help keep you in the action and prevent you from getting caught out without any ammunition.

[*]These tier unlocks are applied to your current progress when buying the Battle Pass. For example, if you are currently on tier 7 when you buy the base Battle Pass, you will unlock 3 tiers and instantly be boosted to tier 10. If you are on tier 20 when you buy the Battle Pass Bundle, you will unlock 20 tiers and instantly be boosted to tier 40.

[h3][b]Battle Pass FAQ[/b][/h3][list]

[b]Q : How do I activate the Battle Pass??[/b]
A : The free course of the Battle Pass will be automatically activated on all accounts. In order to activate the paid course, you will need to purchase the Battle Pass in-game with W Coins.

[b]Q : What is the difference between free tiers and paid tiers?[/b]
A : The paid course provides rewards for all 100 tiers whereas the free course only provides rewards for select tiers. 

[b]Q : If I purchase the Battle Pass, do I still receive the Free track rewards?[/b]
A : Yes, if you purchase the Battle Pass you will receive the paid rewards as well as the free rewards. 

[b]Q : What happens if I decide to buy the Battle Pass later?[/b]
A : If you already made progress in the Battle Pass before deciding to buy it, all previous paid tier rewards will be unlocked instantly when you purchase the battle pass. 

[b]Q :  Is it possible to continue progressing in the Battle Pass after the season ends?[/b]
A : No, the Battle Pass is only available for a limited time and once the season ends, the Battle Pass will no longer be active and the remaining rewards will no longer be obtainable.

[b]Q : Will I keep the Battle Pass items and be able to use them after the season ends?[/b]
A : Yes, you will be able to keep and use all items that you have earned in the Battle Pass even after the season has concluded. 

[b]Q : Are the items obtainable in the Battle Pass exclusive?[/b]
A : Yes, all items are exclusive to the Battle Pass and cannot be obtained in any other way.

[b]Q : Are there any extra rewards available after obtaining all Battle Pass rewards?[/b]
A : Once you have completed tier 100, there are no extra rewards available.

[b]Q : Do all skins in the Battle Pass come with a special reload animation?[/b]

notes.title: February 10 Voice Chat Update
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35212832/fa8cafe5a0f9d4893501d08d6b7f3711d449d4b0.png[/img]

Hello everyone, this is the Ironsight Team.

The in-game voice chat function will be added with the February 10th Update. Use the brand new voice chat feature with your team and party members to gain the upper hand and come out victorious.

In a situation where you have to fight tooth and nail, clear and effective communication can be the determining factor in winning by enhancing the team's unity.

Voice chat will also serve as a laid back communication channel where you can enjoy the casual atmosphere with your friends and team mates and have some fun!

It will also allow you to pass on tips to newer members, teaching them some of the things you have learnt through your experiences.

As there have been many requests from the community for a voice chat feature, we expect that it will be utilized a lot for a variety of different activities and situations!

Please make sure to disconnect from the servers in advance in order to avoid any issues.

[b]Time:[/b][list]
[KST] 14:00 ~ 15:00 February 10th
[CET] 08:00 ~ 09:00 February 10th
[PDT] 21:00 ~ 22:00 February 9th
[/list]



[b][h2]Voice Chat Manual[/h2][/b][list]
Voice chat is divided into two channels, party chat and in-game team chat.

The Party Voice Chat channel is created as soon as a party is created, and players that join the party will instantly join the Party Voice Chat channel.

The Team Voice Chat channel is joined upon entering a game, and is restricted to push to talk only.

FFA game modes such as Battle Royale and Gun Game use proximity chat, with directional audio and dynamic volume depending on the distance between players (with a maximum difference of around 15-20 meters)

[*]If a custom match is joined as a party, the party voice chat will persist even if party members are on different teams.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35212832/c3d10cb20a52a44495113a0b3e9a78db6d82bb6d.png[/img]
Find the [b]Voice Chat[/b] settings by going to [b]Settings[/b] > [b]Audio[/b] > [b]Voice Chat[/b] [list]

[*][b]Voice Chat[/b] : Enable/Disable the Voice Chat feature entirely[list]
   [*][b]Echo Test[/b] Use this option in order to listen to and check your current mic settings.[/list]
[*][b]Party Voice Chat[/b] : Enable/Disable Party Voice Chat 
[*][b]Party Voice Activation Mode[/b] : Choose between Automatic or Push to Talk for Party Voice Chat.
[*][b]Team Voice Chat[/b] : Enable/Disable Team Voice Chat.[list]
    [*]Note: Team Voice Chat is restricted to Push to Talk only.[/list]
[*][b]Output Device[/b]  : Select the device to listen the Voice Chat.
[*][b]Input Device[/b] : Select the device to speak on the Voice Chat.
[*][b]Incoming Volume[/b]  : Output sound level of Voice Chat. 
[*][b]Mic Volume[/b] : The output volume of your microphone.
[*][b]Mic Sensitivity[/b] : How sensitive your mic is when using automatic voice activation.[/list][/list]

[b][h3]Keybind Settings[/h3][/b][list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35212832/d56211371bf6c712ac7b818b4ed5b04691c40193.png[/img]
Adjust your voice chat key-binds in the [b]Settings[/b] > [b]Controls[/b] > [b]Community[/b] tab[list]

[*][b]Player Board[/b] : Mute and report players individually. Default (P)
[*][b]Party Voice Chat[/b] : Default (U) 
[*][b]Team Voice Chat[/b] : Default (V) [/list]
The bomb/flag drop key has been changed to (H). Keyboard settings may have to be reset or manually changed.[/list]

[b][h2]Player Board (In-game)[/h2][/b][list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35212832/d70af60222425b27e61c333e2b33291bf1b4b874.png[/img]
Whilst in a match, press the [b](P)[/b] key to open up the Player Board. On this screen you can mute other players individually by clicking the speaker icon next to their name, or mute your on microphone on the fly by clicking the microphone icon next to your name.

You can also use this screen to report any of the users in the match for chat abuse, cheating, bug abuse, etc.

Muting a player only mutes them in the current Team Voice Chat channel.[list]

[*]Currently [b]Mute[/b] only applies to team voice chat[/list][/list]

[b][h2]Voice Activity Display[/h2][/b][list]
See who is currently talking on the left hand side of the screen. This display will show who is talking in party and team voice chat. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35212832/bb79068702eda84081afd37c4f8460ec213b085a.png[/img]

You can also see who is currently talking on the scoreboard screen by pressing tab.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35212832/bc7b7a1d9505885645abeb09f57b0b15d4964142.png[/img]
[/list]

[b][h2]Note[/h2][/b][list]
[b][h3]Device Settings[/h3][/b][list]

[*]If the device is not displayed in the list, please install the latest drivers and check again.
[*]When changing the microphone or headset device, if the menu screen does not update you may need to close and re-open the menu in order for it to display the correct option.[/list]

[b][h3]Game Policy Update[/h3][/b][list]

[*]Receiving a mute in-game mutes your voice as well as your text chat regardless of which form you used to break the games policy.
[*]Some of Ironsight's Game Policy's have been updated. Please refer to the link below.[list]

[*]Changes are marked in blue
[*]Use the link below to open Ironsight's Game Policy.

[url=https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1uc4r6FhOH2uveNYsRHdfN7KqPZVRa_kMWk3ydr3CB0c/edit?usp=sharing]Ironsight Game & Community Policy[/url]
[/list][/list][/list]

notes.title: 2021 Year Review and 2022 Road Map
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35212832/3a94c3db18f63cdcc17b577221f57ce5e335f8d4.png[/img]

[h1]Introduction[/h1][list]

A new year is upon us and we are excited to see what the future of Ironsight will look like in 2022. Before revealing our plans for the new year though, we thought it would be a good idea to look back at 2021, and all of the things we have been able to accomplish throughout the year.

In 2021, Ironsight was released on GeForce-Now enabling more users the ability to join our amazing community. The game also received significant upgrades to it’s engine and performance, most notably with the addition of Multi-threaded rendering in April which helped users reach higher frame rates than ever before.

We have also tried our best to make use of our community, and listening to them for ideas on what additions or changes should be made to the game ti improve it. Throughout the year we saw a lot of amazing suggestions and thanks to everyone we were able to improve the game with the addition of Gold Attachments and Achievements, In-game Map Callouts, and after hearing your constant feedback we also allowed Custom Parts to be purchasable with GP. We hope to incorporate many more of your suggestions in the new year and we are always listening to your feedback.[/list]

[h1]Events[/h1][list]

Many events were held throughout 2021 ranging from our Seasonal Spring, Summer, and Winter events to our Holidays events such as Halloween, and even a special Black Friday event where players were able to obtain the Black Fried Chicken Mace by completing achievements. 
[previewyoutube=zCsY_w1cJ5c;full][/previewyoutube]

This year’s events saw a lot of upgrades from the previous year, with more interesting challenges like the Halloween Candy Collector challenge, better rewards, and bigger updates such as the brand new Gun Range Mini-Game which was released with the Winter update!  

We can’t wait to start planning all of the events for 2022, and we hope to surprise you along the way with some interesting new ideas![/list]

[h1]Updates[/h1][list]

2021 saw the revival of the Ironsight Battle Pass. [b]Season 4: Ultramarine[/b] was the first iteration of the new Battle Pass system, and it was a great success! Due to it’s popularity the new Battle Pass system has been able to run consistently, with regular Seasons throughout the year giving players amazing new items to unlock and collect every couple of months.  

[previewyoutube=LQRG7NZwSQ4;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]Season 5: Dawn of the Desert[/b] saw Battle Royale receive an update, going from Teams to Solo with more players and larger maps, being made available on Downtown and the newly expanded Outpost map.

[b]Season 6: WWII[/b] came with not only a brand new skill, Device Detection, but also an entirely new map, Rust, and a lot of very popular weapons from history such as the Thompson and the Kar98k!

The most recent season, [b]Codename 7[/b] came with a revamped Gun Game (changing from a Team Mode to an FFA mode with some rule changes), Gold Attachment Achievements, new Male Custom Faces, and an overhaul of how new accounts are initialized and compensated in order to help all new players who join the Ironsight Community!

[previewyoutube=J1bA1Os5628;full][/previewyoutube][/list]

[h1]Weapons[/h1][list]

A slew of new weapons were added to Ironsights arsenal in 2021, from the heavily anticipated Butterfly Knife to the ever popular Kar98k, In total 11 new weapons were added throughout the year, and we have a lot of exciting and interesting weapons lined up for 2022.

In addition, 4 new collection weapons were added; the Black Mamba Blaser, Pietro CheyTac, Artium MP5, and Royal Jester AK-12.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35212832/54973274c7a4e46daa378890e1538867d6b0a5a0.png[/img]
[/list]




[h1]2022 Road Map[/h1][list]

With the continued feedback, suggestions, and support from our Community and Iron Supporters, we will continue to work together in order create a better future for Ironsight by improving upon the aspects that were lacking in 2021, and developing the aspects that you would like to see in the future.

[h2]Weapons[/h2][list]

With the addition of many new awesome weapons, we will also adjust weapon balance so as to help keep the game and it’s meta fresh and entertaining. We will also be looking into buffing and or adjusting weapons that are in desperate need of buffs, or are simply not being used due to other factors.  [/list]

[h2]Skills and Attachments[/h2][list]

We have received numerous opinions and suggestions regarding skills and attachments, and we hope to be able to add some in the new year. We also plan to review the possibility of adding attachments to secondary weapons, and develop and improve the system in the future.[/list]

[h2]Challenges and Achievements[/h2][list]

We plan on improving upon and adding more interesting, interactive and engaging achievements, as well as more rewards to help increase the longevity of the game[/list]

[h2]Modes and Maps[/h2][list]

Cyborg mode is scheduled to be removed from matchmaking, and being made available for special events only.

We will be looking at the Frontline mode and making some adjustments and improvements to it’s balance.

You have been asking for it for a long time now, but in 2022 Resource Takeover will hopefully be making it’s long anticipated return after making some final improvements to the mode and it’s AI.

We have also received numerous suggestions and feedback regarding the Secure Point mode, and how having only 1 active point leads to less strategy. We will revise Secure Point mode to have several active points to secure at once.

There are plans for more special modes (eg Snipers Only, Knife Fights) to be used as special events throughout the year.[/list]

[h2]Voice Chat[/h2][list]

Introducing the Ping and Callout systems has helped to improve team coherence and strategy, but in 2022 we would like to improve upon that even further by adding Voice Chat as a more effective communication method.[/list]

[h2]Sprays[/h2][list]

A spray tag system is planned to be added to the game, giving users more ways to express their emotions and personality in the game directly with various images and tags.[/list]

[h2]Drones[/h2][list]

New drones are planned to be added and we plan on reviewing some of the existing drones and their balance.

The ability to choose loadouts according to the mode, as well as drone skins are also things we are looking at releasing this year.[/list]

[h2]Battle Pass[/h2][list]

We will prepare more diverse, varied, and unique Battle Passes and Rank Seasons.[/list]

[h2]Netcode and Matchmaking[/h2][list]

Although improvements have been made, we understand that many people still feel that this area of the game is a drawback and that recent improvements have not been enough. We will work harder in order to create a more pleasant, smooth, and seamless experience for everyone.[/list][/list]




Since it’s launch on Steam, more than 1.75 million users have joined Ironsight, and we are thrilled to currently have more than 10,000 daily active users. 

We are very grateful for the dedicated fans we have, and we will continue to work hard in order to improve and update the game.

Thank you!

From everyone here at Wiple Games we would like to wish you all a Happy Holidays! We are sincerely appreciative of all of your support throughout the year, and we are very excited for what the new year holds for Ironsight's future.

To celebrate the holiday season and show our appreciation, there is an in-game log-in event as well as a GP/XP boosting event in-game. Anyone who logs into the game during this time will receive a free Winter Box, and an increased GP/XP rate!

On top of this, there is also a new Winter Coupon Code! Make your way to the store and find the #Coupon Code button in the bottom right corner. Enter this seasons code in order to obtain a special present!

notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35212832/8d869d36ecfcf27eb494b6b02a4f19438454fb7e.png[/img]

Hello everyone, this is the Ironsight Team.

Codename 7 will be active starting on the 16th of December.

The new Season 7 Battle Pass consists of 100 tiers, filled with a variety of equipment from Ironsights secret agents, and including two new weapons (the HK416 assault rifle and the P30 pistol), an Epic Bowie Knife, emotes, costume parts, unique skins, and even one of the materials needed to obtain the brand new Royal Jester AK-12 Collection Weapon.

Season 7 also introduces the newest mode, Gun Game (Solo). This is an FFA mode and can be queued for through the matchmaking quickplay system.   

In addition, the team has revisited some of the decisions that were made when Ironsight was first developed regarding new accounts, and as a result some changes will be made to improve the experience for new users. For example, all items that were initially given to new accounts temporarily will now be permanent, and loadout's have been adjusted to make it easier for new players to adapt to the game. We will continue to make such improvements in the future.

Furthermore, the team are also currently making various efforts to increase the enjoyment of all players, and providing more content for them to enjoy. Among these efforts are the new Gold Attachment Challenges that have been added for all the players who have been seeking a new challenge and goal to work towards.

Please read about the update and its contents in more detail below!

[b]Battle Pass Details[/b][list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35212832/d7e9e5da0c058c1af952ee37bfdec1ab3027bc54.png[/img]
[*]Access the Battle Pass in the bottom right corner of the main lobby screen. Here you can inspect all 100 tiers and check your current progress.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35212832/2f440a16955cc81d190ddb05cdbf2562931926ab.png[/img]
[*]The Battle Pass can be bought by itself or as part of a bundle package which comes with more tiers already unlocked.
[*]The base Battle Pass comes with 3 tiers unlocked and can be bought for 9,900 W coin, whereas the bundle comes with 20 tiers already unlocked and can be bought for 24,000 W coin.
[*]These tier unlocks are applied to your current progress when buying the Battle Pass. For example, if you are currently on tier 7 when you buy the base Battle Pass, you will unlock 3 tiers and instantly be boosted to tier 10. If you are on tier 20 when you buy the Battle Pass Bundle, you will unlock 20 tiers and instantly be boosted to tier 40.
[*]After buying the Battle Pass, you will have the option to purchase as many tiers as you want using Chips. (Each tier costs 15 Chips)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35212832/6630457ad0daebee102708f7186203671b090e09.png[/img]

[*]You will progress through the Battle Pass as you earn XP in Ironsight. The bar at the bottom of the Battle Pass screen displays your current progress.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35212832/b9c56aade3ae404a7e1911ce11e19c34b7475370.png[/img]
[*]You can also check your Battle Pass progress at the end of each game on the Match Results screen.
[/list]

[h3][b]Battle Pass FAQ[/b][/h3][list]

[b]Q : How do I activate the Battle Pass??[/b]
A : The free course of the Battle Pass will be automatically activated on all accounts. In order to activate the paid course, you will need to purchase the Battle Pass in-game with W Coins.

[b]Q : What is the difference between free tiers and paid tiers?[/b]
A : The paid course provides rewards for all 100 tiers whereas the free course only provides rewards for select tiers. 

[b]Q : If I purchase the Battle Pass, do I still receive the Free track rewards?[/b]
A : Yes, if you purchase the Battle Pass you will receive the paid rewards as well as the free rewards. 

[b]Q : What happens if I decide to buy the Battle Pass later?[/b]
A : If you already made progress in the Battle Pass before deciding to buy it, all previous paid tier rewards will be unlocked instantly when you purchase the battle pass. 

[b]Q :  Is it possible to continue progressing in the Battle Pass after the season ends?[/b]
A : No, the Battle Pass is only available for a limited time and once the season ends, the Battle Pass will no longer be active and the remaining rewards will no longer be obtainable.

[b]Q : Will I keep the Battle Pass items and be able to use them after the season ends?[/b]
A : Yes, you will be able to keep and use all items that you have earned in the Battle Pass even after the season has concluded. 

[b]Q : Are the items obtainable in the Battle Pass exclusive?[/b]
A : Yes, all items are exclusive to the Battle Pass and cannot be obtained in any other way.

[b]Q : Are there any extra rewards available after obtaining all Battle Pass rewards?[/b]
A : Once you have completed tier 100, there are no extra rewards available.

[b]Q : Do all skins in the Battle Pass come with a special reload animation?[/b]
A : No. Special animations are only available for some skins. If you would like to check if a weapon comes with a special reload animation, please test it out using the gun-range.
[/list]

notes.title: 2021 Skin Design Contest
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35212832/96612ed2292deb0bbdee13d63a495d413f245b2a.png[/img]

Hello, this is the Ironsight Team!

We are excited to announce the 2021 Community Skin Design Contest! This is your chance to show off your design talents and have your finished product put into the game!

[h2][b]Event Details[/b][/h2]

Choose any of the weapons from the list below and create your own unique design! After the event, we will hold a survey where the community will vote on the best designs. The winning designs will be developed into actual skins for the game, with the creators callsign engraved into the description! [list]
[h3]Weapon List[/h3][list]
- [[url=https://drive.google.com/file/d/11de3lNFeTUtS-K96Tnnh0dgyPVpqQiFD/view]G36C[/url]]
- [[url=https://drive.google.com/file/d/11rFJK8hRabFnqdHCv3Q-Pld2n7YatQog/view]Mx4 Storm[/url]]
- [[url=https://drive.google.com/file/d/1m2TlmoTBOQWuP2OBSOUZ63hcYR0Ke19X/view]Kar98k[/url]]
- [[url=https://drive.google.com/file/d/1vkYUz_ki-VTXA6BDtjmz7nGN31e_omuO/view]M9A1[/url]]
- [[url=https://drive.google.com/file/d/1V3hxznDis0Tqdq4_CznvUOkYkuXGFSu8/view]Tactical Axe[/url]]
[/list]
[/list]

[h2][b]How to Enter[/b][/h2]
[list]
Download any templates you need from above and create your design(s) using any application of your choosing. You can create a maximum of 1 design per weapon, for a total maximum of up to 5. 

Once you are finished, send the completed product as both a [b]PNG[/b] and a [b]Project File[/b] (eg. PSD file from Photoshop) to [url=support@wiplegames.com]support@wiplegames.com[/url]. After reviewing all of the entries, we will create a survey and let the community decide which designs are the best!

[h3]Important![/h3]
When emailing your submission, please use the following format:[list]
[*]Email Title : Weapon Design Contest
[*]Email Body : [u]Please include your :[/u][list]
- In-game Callsign and Discord Username 
- Name of your design 
- And don't forget to attach your design file to the email! (PNG and Project File)[/list]
[/list]
[/list]
[b][h2]Event Schedule[/h2][/b][list]

[b][i]Application Date[/i][/b] - October 29th - November 26th 

[b][i]Internal Review[/i][/b] - November 27th - November 29th

[b][i]Community Poll[/i][/b] - November 30th - December 3rd

- Any submissions received after the deadline will unfortunately not be up for consideration.
All entries will be reviewed internally before the poll is made public to ensure that all submissions abide by the contest rules.[/list]

[b][h2]Rewards[/h2][/b][list]
[b][h3]Winners[/h3][/b][list]
The best skin for each of the 5 weapons will be selected via a community poll. Wiple also reserves the right to choose additional winners if they believe any of the other submissions are deserving of the prize and being added to the game.

The winning designs will be released in game as official skins for players to use. As a winning designer, your in-game callsign will be attached to your skin forever by being credited in the skins description, and you will of course receive your own personally designed skin for free!

On top of this, the selected winners will also receive the upcoming Season 7 Battle Pass Bundle for free when it is released![/list]

[b][h3]Participation Rewards[/h3][/b][list]
All participants who submitted at least 1 design to the contest will receive a Community Box once the winning skins have been added to the game.

[i](Note: If your submission(s) is deemed to have been made without any effort, or is suspected of containing copyrighted material; Wiple reserves the right to disqualify the submission and it will not be eligible to receive any participation rewards)[/i][/list][/list]

[b][h3]Notice[/h3][/b][list]
- Only original designs will be accepted.
- Please refrain from submitting any sexual, political, religious, or otherwise offensive designs. Wiple Games reserves the right to exclude any controversial designs.
- Do not use any copyrighted materials. (If your design infringes on another's copyright, it will be disqualified.
- No skin sets are allowed. If you submit multiple weapon skins, each weapon should have a unique design and theme.
- If a dispute/conflict related to any of these topics arises after the skin has been released, it's use may be restricted and the designer may be held accountable.

If you have any questions please contact Wiple_Brilson or Wiple_Taylor on [url=https://discord.com/invite/ironsight]Discord[/url] or send an email to [url=support@wiplegames.com]support@wiplegames.com[/url].

[/list]

notes.title: New Map: Rust
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35212832/1bf3a5ecd06feea14fc1fb39dc9dec3fbd2e46bf.jpg[/img]

Ironsight's newest map, [b]Rust[/b], is here!

Located in a small village in an abandoned industrial area, Rust's wide open areas should come as a breath of fresh air for grizzled veterans of battle, who have become accustomed to the tighter and more claustrophobic war zones in other areas. Equip a Sniper Rifle and unlock it's maximum potential in Rust's vast, open areas, or take refuge in one of the many abandoned factories spread across the map.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35212832/5c5ed4242586052c4f3cf6f2ef870a6b0aa5bcde.png[/img]

[h2]Release Information
[/h2][list]
[*]Initially, Team Deathmatch will be the only playable mode on Rust as we test and gather feedback from the community. Further mode support will be added at a later date.
[*]Rust will be available in Custom Games, and Online Games when you are queuing for Team Deathmatch.

The servers will be down on the 16th of September whilst we apply the update.

[h3][b]Battle Pass Season 6: WWII[/b][/h3]

Earn rewards for just playing the game! The Ironsight Battle Pass consists of 100 tiers with unique items on both the free track, and the paid track! These skins are only obtainable through this specific Battle Pass season so don't miss out!

Season 6 Schedule : 2021/09/16 - 2021/12/08 (KST)  

[b]Rewards[/b]
Let's take a closer look at what the WWII Battle Pass has to offer!

[previewyoutube=lb-7-4z70h4;full][/previewyoutube]


[b]Battle Pass Details[/b][list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35212832/dedb8d813a1276d9c1823e40bf7181d34fd7f3cd.png[/img]
[*]Access the Battle Pass in the bottom right corner of the main lobby screen. Here you can inspect all 100 tiers and check your current progress.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35212832/5209b0902c233dda832f34f4bc16aa0b6f64a53b.png[/img]
[*]The Battle Pass can be bought by itself or as part of a bundle package which comes with more tiers already unlocked.
[*]The base Battle Pass comes with 3 tiers unlocked and can be bought for 9,900 W coin, whereas the bundle comes with 20 tiers already unlocked and can be bought for 24,000 W coin. 
[*]These tier unlocks are applied to your current progress when buying the Battle Pass. For example, if you are currently on tier 7 when you buy the base Battle Pass, you will unlock 3 tiers and instantly be boosted to tier 10. If you are on tier 20 when you buy the Battle Pass Bundle, you will unlock 20 tiers and instantly be boosted to tier 40.
[*]After buying the Battle Pass, you will have the option to purchase as many tiers as you want using Chips. (Each tier costs 15 Chips)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35212832/37042afb7d4dff8f618c02e6ec4d14e51bccfd25.png[/img]
[*]Each tier costs 15 Chips to unlock.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35212832/748623ea4bfd17d3d87e8364ff820e2ba644924d.png[/img]
[*]You will progress through the Battle Pass as you earn XP in Ironsight. The bar at the bottom of the Battle Pass screen displays your current progress.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35212832/4dc2ff10746731f58ae4053effe09663cc142b4a.png[/img]
[*]You can also check your Battle Pass progress at the end of each game on the Match Results screen.
[/list]

[h3][b]Battle Pass FAQ[/b][/h3][list]

[b]Q : How do I activate the Battle Pass??[/b]
A : The free course of the Battle Pass will be automatically activated on all accounts. In order to activate the paid course, you will need to purchase the Battle Pass in-game with W Coins.

[b]Q : What is the difference between free tiers and paid tiers?[/b]
A : The paid course provides rewards for all 100 tiers whereas the free course only provides rewards for select tiers. 

[b]Q : If I purchase the Battle Pass, do I still receive the Free track rewards?[/b]
A : Yes, if you purchase the Battle Pass you will receive the paid rewards as well as the free rewards. 

[b]Q : What happens if I decide to buy the Battle Pass later?[/b]
A : If you already made progress in the Battle Pass before deciding to buy it, all previous paid tier rewards will be unlocked instantly when you purchase the battle pass. 

[b]Q :  Is it possible to continue progressing in the Battle Pass after the season ends?[/b]
A : No, the Battle Pass is only available for a limited time and once the season ends, the Battle Pass will no longer be active and the remaining rewards will no longer be obtainable.

[b]Q : Will I keep the Battle Pass items and be able to use them after the season ends?[/b]
A : Yes, you will be able to keep and use all items that you have earned in the Battle Pass even after the season has concluded. 

[b]Q : Are the items obtainable in the Battle Pass exclusive?[/b]
A : Yes, all items are exclusive to the Battle Pass and cannot be obtained in any other way.

[b]Q : Are there any extra rewards available after obtaining all Battle Pass rewards?[/b]
A : Once you have completed tier 100 and obtained the 'Overlord Tar-21' and 'WWII Completed' Emblem, there are no extra rewards available.

[b]Q : Do all skins in the Battle Pass come with a special reload animation?[/b]
A : No. Special animations are only available for some skins. If you would like to check if a weapon comes with a special reload animation, please test it out using the gun-range.
[/list]

[*]Added an option to determine if Hit-markers are client or server sided.

When dealing damage to opponents, changes the processing of hit-markers displayed to server or local.

Deactivate - [Default] Conventional method that, after you hit your opponent, the server confirms the hit registered and then a hit-marker is display.
Activate - [Local] When you hit the opponent, a hit-marker is displayed immediately. Due to the hit-marker being displayed before the server confirms the hit, hit markers may be displayed even when hit's are not being registered by the server.

This has been added as an option in response to user feedback about hit's not registering because of network delay, and to help with any hit-registration issues in the future.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35212832/6b5177675127d6f619cebdf2263d02ebe4f82121.png[/img]

Thank you to everyone for showing so much interest in Kalli's Summer Box, and all of the amazing new Summer Items.

We ran a Selection Coupon Event for anyone who was supportive enough to open 100 boxes, but we have heard that it is still not enough to satisfy your appetite for the Summer items! As a result we have prepared an additional event for those of you who are still looking for more.

Users who managed to receive the Selection Coupon after opening a hundred of Kalli's Summer Boxes, will now be able to obtain 1 more Selection Coupon after opening another 100 boxes.

If you believe you are eligible for the event, please do not forget to apply through the link below.

[h3][b][url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/1yWVulyNgeNBa8eeQwbD2I3Qod7lAelZ6YVwkCJbNlcY]Event Application Form[/url][/b][/h3]

[*]Coupons will be sent in order of application on weekdays at 2pm KST.

notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35212832/e9fa06afd695a38ad26da24ef0cb0379e149c0fb.png[/img]

We hope everyone has been enjoying Ranked Season 5! We have seen a huge improvement in participation and because of this the leaderboards have been extremely active!

Solo Ranked will be closing next week on the 21st of July (KST).  Now is your chance to make the final push and reach whichever rank you've had your eyes set on! Don't forget their are Daily Ranked Missions to help you gather chips every day as well, and special rewards will be handed out depending on how high you manage to climb on the ladder!

[*]1st
[*]2nd
[*]3rd
[*]Top 10

[*]Top 100 (Solo and Duel Only)
[*]Participant[/list]

The top 100 players at the end of the Solo Ranked season will be eligible to receive a unique skin for the M1911 pistol.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35212832/e0992413cd979b0790fe48e2eb52267ceb3eb5b9.png[/img]


[u][h3][b]Clan Wars[/b][/h3][/u]
Participating members of the top 10 Clans on the Clan Wars leaderboards will receive a specially designed skin for the ACOG scope.

(Only Clan Members who participated in at least 1 match for their Clan during the season will be eligible to receive the Clan Wars rewards)

At the end of the Duel season, the top 100 players on the leaderboards will be rewarded with a unique skin for the silencer.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35212832/b2cf55d58e3b90fff95b5c47431baef34a69498d.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35212832/a84ccde6e01f2c867985e5b49536d27c9e04317a.png[/img]

notes.title: Battle Pass FAQ
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35212832/2521020fd4714d8bc8a4df4cd63d1ab798a9c49f.png[/img]



[h3][b]Battle Pass Details[/b][/h3][list]
Earn rewards for playing the game when you unlock Battle Pass tiers containing unique items.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35212832/5fabd6a60fa13fb1519dac9a5b2b5564f04cebd9.png[/img]
[*]Access the Battle Pass in the bottom right corner of the main lobby screen. Here you can inspect all 100 tiers and check your current progress.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35212832/4ffd708476406921a89823d795adb4320d65cb2e.png[/img]
[*]The Battle Pass can be bought by itself or as part of a bundle package which comes with more tiers already unlocked.
[*]The base Battle Pass comes with 3 tiers unlocked and can be bought for 9,900 W coin, whereas the bundle comes with 20 tiers already unlocked and can be bought for 24,000 W coin. 
[*]These tier unlocks are applied to your current progress when buying the Battle Pass. For example, if you are currently on tier 7 when you buy the base Battle Pass, you will unlock 3 tiers and instantly be boosted to tier 10. If you are on tier 20 when you buy the Battle Pass Bundle, you will unlock 20 tiers and instantly be boosted to tier 40.
[*]After buying the Battle Pass, you will have the option to purchase as many tiers as you want using Chips. (Each tier costs 15 Chips)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35212832/d7dd0beac0fc2c01d5111a661715ff2979a97f0a.png[/img]
[*]Each tier costs 15 Chips to unlock.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35212832/0608bb1462daee5fc38417319d35c82924387684.png[/img]
[*]You will progress through the Battle Pass as you earn XP in Ironsight. The bar at the bottom of the Battle Pass screen displays your current progress.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35212832/e4123f2d807be5c066ea91ae644538ebf92d8a04.png[/img]
[*]You can also check your Battle Pass progress at the end of each game on the Match Results screen.
[/list]
[h3][b]Battle Pass FAQ[/b][/h3][list]

[b]Q : How do I activate the Battle Pass??[/b]
A : The free course of the Battle Pass will be automatically activated on all accounts. In order to activate the paid course, you will need to purchase the Battle Pass in-game with W Coins.

[b]Q : What is the difference between free tiers and paid tiers?[/b]
A : The paid course provides rewards for all 100 tiers whereas the free course only provides rewards for select tiers. 

[b]Q : If I purchase the Battle Pass, do I still receive the Free track rewards?[/b]
A : Yes, if you purchase the Battle Pass you will receive the paid rewards as well as the free rewards. 

[b]Q : What happens if I decide to buy the Battle Pass later?[/b]
A : If you already made progress in the Battle Pass before deciding to buy it, all previous paid tier rewards will be unlocked instantly when you purchase the battle pass. 

[b]Q :  Is it possible to continue progressing in the Battle Pass after the season ends?[/b]
A : No, the Battle Pass is only available for a limited time and once the season ends, the Battle Pass will no longer be active and the remaining rewards will no longer be obtainable.

[b]Q : Will I keep the Battle Pass items and be able to use them after the season ends?[/b]
A : Yes, you will be able to keep and use all items that you have earned in the Battle Pass even after the season has concluded. 

[b]Q : Are the items obtainable in the Battle Pass exclusive?[/b]
A : Yes, all items are exclusive to the Battle Pass and cannot be obtained in any other way.

[b]Q : Are there any extra rewards available after obtaining all Battle Pass rewards?[/b]
A : Once you have completed tier 100 and obtained the 'Desert Fox AUG' and 'Dawn of the Desert Completed' Emblem,  there are no extra rewards available.

[b]Q : Do all skins in the Battle Pass come with a special reload animation?[/b]
A : No. Special animations are only available for some skins. If you would like to check if a weapon comes with a special reload animation, please test it out using the gun-range.
[/list]

[b]Battle Pass Details[/b][list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35212832/0f3912c618496a537ffde65168940e26beb5c513.png[/img]
[*]Access the Battle Pass in the bottom right corner of the main lobby screen. Here you can inspect all 100 tiers and check your current progress.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35212832/b9dbb74c454eaa64511836d1083965711ab47120.png[/img][*]The Battle Pass can be bought by itself or as part of a bundle package which includes more tier unlocks. 
[*]The base Battle Pass comes with 3 tiers unlocked and can be bought for 9,900 W coin, whereas the Bundle comes with 20 tiers and can be bought for 24,000 W coin.
[*]These tier unlocks are applied to your current progress when buying the Battle Pass. For example, if you are currently on tier 7 when you buy the base Battle Pass, you will instantly be boosted to tier 10.  If you are on tier 20 when you buy the Battle Pass Bundle, you will instantly be boosted to tier 40.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35212832/ba51f88337da1811f2d3c0e0628db1460ede928a.png[/img]

[h3][b]Battle Pass FAQ[/b][/h3][list]

[b]Q : How do I activate the Battle Pass?[/b]
A : The free course of the Battle Pass will be automatically activated on all accounts. In order to activate the paid course, you will need to purchase the Battle Pass in-game with W Coins.

[b]Q : The free course of the Battle Pass will be automatically activated on all accounts. In order to activate the paid course, you will need to purchase the Battle Pass in-game with W Coins?[/b]
A : The paid course provides rewards for all 100 tiers whereas the free course only includes rewards for select tiers.

[b]Q : If I purchase the Battle Pass, do I still receive the Free track rewards?[/b]
A : Yes, if you purchase the Battle Pass you will receive the Paid rewards as well as the free rewards.

[b]Q : What happens if I decide to buy the Battle Pass later?[/b]
A : If you already made progress in the Battle Pass before deciding to buy it, all previous tier rewards will be unlocked instantly when you purchase the battle pass. 

[b]Q : Is it possible to continue progressing in the Battle Pass after the season ends?[/b]
A : No, the Battle Pass is only available for a limited time and once the season ends, the Battle Pass will no longer be active and the remaining rewards will no longer be obtainable.

[b]Q : Will I keep the Battle Pass items and be able to use them after the season ends?[/b]
A : Yes, you will be able to keep and use all items that you have earned in the Battle Pass.

[b]Q : Are the items obtainable in the Battle Pass exclusive?[/b]
A : Yes, all items are exclusive to the Battle Pass and cannot be obtained in any other way.. 

[b]Q : Are there any extra rewards available after obtaining all Battle Pass rewards?[/b]
A : No, once all 100 tier rewards have been obtained, there are no extra rewards available. 
 [/list]
