notes.title: 2020 Year in Review
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35212832/c56094a85a6f4e798d071775bdce236acbfd3502.jpg[/img]

It's a new year, and we would like to start off by thanking each and every one of you for being a part of Ironsight! During 2020, Ironsight changed and accomplished a lot, and we are glad to be able to communicate so clearly and directly with the playerbase in order to continually improve the game.

This year, Wiple Games launched servers in South East Asia, Europe, North America, and South America, and subsequently took control of global publishing responsibilities. We hope to continue to deliver an amazing experience to all of our fans located in different areas all around the globe, and perhaps even launching new servers in regions that show lots of interest and support for Ironsight.

2020 also saw the beginning of Ironsight's partnership with EasyAntiCheat. Since its integration, there has been a very noticeable drop in hacking reports and we hope in 2021 the amount of weekly reports drops even lower. We will continue to work towards eradicating cheaters in the new year and create a fairer and cleaner game for everyone.

[h2]Events[/h2]

We ran our first 3 seasons of Clan Wars in 2020 and learned a lot about what works well and what doesn't. We will take everything we have learned and use it to create more fulfilling and satisfying competitive modes and events in the future. Our Community Guidelines were also released and the first few Ironsight sponsored Community Tournaments were held. We hope to see a lot more events like this in 2021, and a lot more participants!

As for seasonal events, Ironsight saw special updates for Spring, Summer and Winter, along with holiday events for special days such as Valentines Day, White Day, Halloween and Christmas. These events will make a regular appearance every year but I imagine there is room for improvements to make each year and each event more memorable than the last!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35212832/419835873f7c610a7f9f74beb243d6b4529d9b3f.png[/img]
[i]The Halloween Update was a huge success in 2020![/i]


Our last Battle Pass was released almost a year ago in February 2020. We felt there was a lot of changes that needed to be made in order to provide a better product for the customers and as a result we haven't released a Battle Pass since then. We want to ensure that if we release a Battle Pass, it has great value for the players, and although nothing is confirmed yet, if we create another Battle Pass we want to ensure it is something that is rewarding, satisfying, and engaging.

The community also had some chances to get involved with special events such as the Skin Design Contest, Video Editing Contest (Check out the winning entry below) and Gun Range UCC Contest. We love it when the community get's involved and it allows everyone to show off their expertise and creativity.

[previewyoutube=KOhfvomX8Ow;full][/previewyoutube]


[h2]Updates[/h2]

2020 saw the release of many new weapons in Ironsight, including the QBZ 95, L96A1, Honey Badger, Mx4 Storm, M1014, and OTS-14. These guns came with hundreds of new skins, charms, attachments and costumes for players to customize their characters with. We love creating new content and guns for everyone to get their hands on, and we hope to release more highly-requested guns, costumes and skins in 2021, along with some guns that may be a bit unconventional and unexpected!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35212832/1d9d78847ec8e3c2e7eb0fd3ff17afbca7c6d40a.jpg[/img]
[i]The Haruyama map was released as part of the Spring Update.[/i]


We also released the maps Haruyama and Observatory last year and with the help of the everyone we have been able to find and fix many exploits and glitches on all of our maps. Alongside these maps, many new and unique game modes starting with Team Battle Royale, Cyborg Mode, and Gun Deathmatch were developed. We plan to test out and introduce some new mode ideas in the new year, and possibly even re-visit some old ideas and game modes to make them even better!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35212832/51227f53875359330f958378334aaa7dff566859.jpg[/img]
[i]Observatory has seen quite a lot of popularity since it's release in early 2020![/i]


The game has also received many new features at the request of the it's players including a replay feature, gun range, and ping system. We will continue to improve and perfect these features going into 2021, and we are always looking out for any new features that everyone is asking for. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35212832/40716e464e56435ddaef51b9a5bd6c27c2d70ec5.jpg[/img]
[i]The new gun-range allowed players to test guns out and see what new skins looked like before buying them.[/i]


[h2]Future[/h2]

Moving forward, we have many plans for Ironsight in 2021. Although we can't share all of our plans with you just yet, we want to assure everyone that we review feedback regularly and plan to focus on some of the issues that are constantly brought up by the community. These issues include  matchmaking and match balancing, netcode and server performance, and engine optimization. Hopefully, with steady, persistent updates, we will be able to deliver a smoother, more enjoyable experience for everyone who plays Ironsight . With these updates, plus lots of little surprises along the way, we hope the Ironsight Community can grow even more in the future.

Thank you again to all of our fans and everyone who supports us. We cannot wait to show you what we have planned for 2021!

Who is the ultimate firearms expert? You will need mastery of all types of weapons to win in this mode!



[h3][b]1. Gun Deathmatch[/b][/h3][list]
[*]Objective :  Kill enemies using a variety of 18 different guns to win.
[*]Win Condition : The team with the first player to complete the final level is the winning team.
[*]No. of Players : 6 - 12
[*]Rounds : 1
[*]Respawns  : On
[*]Time Limit : 10 Minutes
[*]Teams Swap Sides : No
[*]Maps : Titan, Observatory, Oceanfront, Airport, Tower, Station, Haruyama

In order to win Gun Deathmatch you will need a diverse skill set and to be familiar with all of the weapons in Ironsight. [/list]

[h3][b]2. Gameplay[/b][/h3][list]
[*]Each player starts with the same weapon and has the same progression path.
[*]Skills are not applied.
[*]Attachments from your loadout's do not apply
[*]Each time you get 2 kills with a weapon, you advance to the next level.
[*]Completing all 18 levels ends the game and awards your team the victory .
[*]If you kill the player in first place on the opposing team, you will receive credit for 2 kills and instantly advance to the next level.
[*]If you kill another player using a melee attack, you will instantly advance to the next level.
[*]If you are killed by a melee attack, you will regress to the previous level.
[*]Playing Gun Deathmatch does not affect your KDR or KDA.
[/list]

[h3][b]3.Achievements and Rewards[/b][/h3][list]

notes.title: Cyborg Mode
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35212832/b03dea5e927df0bc853ba8e09732fbe9b45eaa6d.png[/img]

[h3][b]Overview[/b][/h3]
Humans vs Cyborgs

The Cyborgs win by killing and converting all Humans into Cyborgs
The Humans win by surviving for the designated amount of time.

When a Human dies, they turn into a Cyborg and become hostile towards the other Humans.


[h3][b]Basic Rules[/b][/h3][list]
[*]Objective : As a Human try to stay alive for as long as you can! Cyborgs win if they successfully kill and convert all of the Humans before time runs out.
[*]Win Condition : Cyborg - Convert all Humans, Humans - Stay alive until time is up.
[*]Number of Players : 6 - 12
[*]Rounds : 1
[*]Respawns  : On
[*]Time Limit : 5 minutes
[*]Teams Swap Sides : No
[*]Available Maps: Mart, Island, Ironworks, Cruise
[*]KDA in Cyborg Mode is only recorded in the mode specific records and is not reflected in your general records.
[*]During Halloween, Mart has become extremely foggy and is only available in Cyborg Mode.
(Don’t worry, the fog will subside and Mart will return to the other game modes once Halloween has passed!)

[/list]
[previewyoutube=-J7s9wJDUpc;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3][b]Gameplay[/b][/h3][list]
[*]All players start as Humans
[*]Humans must prepare by collecting weapons, grenades, and attachments that are spread around the map
[*]After 15 seconds, one player is selected at random and converted into a Cyborg
[*]When a Cyborg kills a Human, that Human is converted into a Cyborg
[*]The first Cyborg of the match is a unique and powerful 'Heavy' model that starts with 500 health
[*]Cyborgs now have unlimited Stamina
[*]Cyborgs will spawn with 1 Throwing Knife every second time they spawn.
[*]The initial ‘Heavy Cyborg’ spawns with 2 Throwing Knives and 2 Tear Gas canisters
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35212832/2f35f9648c872073a5ec8acd9d95d58425a847e1.png[/img]

[/list]
[h3][b]Supply Boxes and Drones[/b][/h3][list]
Humans have a set list of drones that they must use [list]
[*] Firefly
[*] Storm Shield Drone
[*] Hydra
[/list]
Score is based on kills, time played, and loot. 

When killed, Cyborgs will drop:[list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35212832/4b9745f2d568f59699008bde3105182dfd597545.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35212832/6e7509f13816382e3f3c49cd46ee39e1ad536f0d.png[/img]
[*][b]Trinitium[/b] which allows Humans to call drones faster.
[*][b]Supply Boxes[/b] that replenish ammo for both Primary and Secondary weapons.[/list]
[/list]
[h3][b]Rewards[/b][/h3][list]
Each match of Cyborg Mode played will reward EXP and GP.

[h3]Emblem[/h3]
Obtained after achieving [Cyborg Mode Pro]
100 wins in Cyborg Mode
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35212832/b8e05d33dea1e12b06fe7a63b80d02b835cc7dd9.png[/img]
[h3]Title[/h3]
Obtained after achieving [Cyborg Mode God]
500 wins in Cyborg Mode
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35212832/722f2c96cf5af5f4936ed374114be68b25f249e6.png[/img]
[/list]
[h3][b]Matchmaking[/b][/h3][list]
Like Battle Royale previously, Cyborg Mode will be added to the regular playlist, as well as getting its own spot on the main menu in order to improve visibility and subsequently matchmaking effectiveness. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35212832/63456b337c38ee7f2b2a730181d64bed3f5e6882.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35212832/35f23ca67b95f0cd3e3916af4c7d295942fa71e3.png[/img]

With the addition of Cyborg Mode, playlist settings have been reset. [All modes are selected by default]
[/list]

Hello, this is the Ironsight Team!

Who will be the ultimate clan this time? The long-awaited Clan Match Season 3 has finally arrived! Find out more information below.


[b]1. Clan Match Regular Season[/b]
[list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35212832/ae74f0d524916f63580f338f11158be7c3910305.png[/img]
[*][[b]Season Rule Changes[/b]] Starting this season, each server will have its own leaderboard.
When your clan plays on a different server, your clan records will be applied to the corresponding server.
[/list]

[b]2. League Rank Table[/b]
[list]
[*] Rewards will be given out according to your rank at the end of the season. 
     Join a clan and see how high you can get!
[*] You can confirm your rank on your Clan Page.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35212832/860368e758a222aa664dc60f7ee1a2687fa3fd4d.jpg[/img]
[*]Clan Inactivity Penalty: 10 points will be deducted if a Clan does not play on a server for 1 week*
[/list]


[b]3. Clan Match Season 3 Rewards[/b]

Rewards are broken down into the following categories:

[list]
[*] [b][Daily Clan Match Reward][/b] Rewarded each day for participating in Clan Matches.
[*] [b][Play Mission Reward][/b] Rewarded for playing Clan Matches a certain amount of times.
[*] [b][Clan Match Bonus][/b] Rewarded automatically every time you enter a Clan Match.
[*] [b][In-game Clan Banners][/b] Rewarded to the top 3 clans of the season.
[*] [b][Season Rank Reward][/b] Rewarded based on your ranking at the end of the season.
[/list]

Don’t miss your chance to enjoy the various rewards and benefits of Clan Matches!
[list]

[b](1).Daily Clan Match Reward[/b]
You can receive the following rewards for each specific number of times you participate in Clan Matches.
Matches played as a mercenary also count towards this mission.
[list]
[*]How to get this reward
You can confirm your current progress by clicking on 'Clan Match' in the 'Daily Clan Match' tab in the main lobby. Whenever you receive an award it will be sent to your storage.

- Check out the Rose Gold weapon skins below. These can only be found in the Clan Match Supply Box and the Superior Clan Match Supply Box!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35212832/36084cf1356cbd54ebb41180c03bb9f07d5a2f2d.png[/img]
[/list]


[b](2). Clan Match Bonus[/b]
[list]
EXP and GP granted from Clan Matches receive a 10% extra bonus.
[/list]

[b](3). Rose Gold Weapons[/b]
[list]
Participate in Clan Matches and find Rose Gold weapon skins in Clan Match Supply Boxes and Superior Clan Match Supply Boxes.
[previewyoutube=9yyvhtIEDWg;full][/previewyoutube]
[/list]

[b](4). Play Mission Rewards[/b]
[list]
If you are able to complete the set number of Clan Matches, you will receive the rewards listed below.
Matches played as a mercenary also count towards this mission. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35212832/01e01d5d12656fc28d44a4b16c2eb2c503c1ba5b.png[/img]
[/list]

[b](5). The Highest Honor of Season 3![/b][list]
After the conclusion of Season 3, banners branding the marks of the top 3 teams will be placed in 3 areas of each map.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35212832/2dab982b72498c3320894036de897f11e2d69a5d.jpg[/img]
[/list]

[b](6). Season Rank Rewards[/b]
[list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35212832/f109a26a981f693e992b19381ef38f861927d156.png[/img]
[*]You can not receive duplicate rewards from different regions.

After the announcement of Clan Wars seasons 3, we have received a lot of feedback.*
After discussing this feedback internally, we have decided to make the following changes:
[list]
[*]The Global rankings will be changed to represent a clans combined score from all servers.*
[*]Clan Wars will be available 24 hours. (Instead of from 20:00 - 6:00 KST)*
[*]In the event of a tie, the winner will be decided by win percentages.*
[/list]
[/list]
[/list]

[b]4. Reward Payment[/b]
[list]
[*]All rewards earned during the season will be delivered to your storage within 2 weeks of the seasons conclusion.
[/list]

[b]5.Regarding reward distribution[/b]
[list]
[*]Your team must consist of at least 3 clan members for it to count towards the season.
[*]If you withdraw in the middle of the season you will not receive any rewards. 
[*]Only clan members who are in the clan up until the seasons closes can receive Clan Match benefits.
[*]Regardless of when the clan was made, if you participated in a Clan Match you can receive rewards.
[*]Even if you are a member of a clan, if you do not participate in any Clan Matches you will not receive any rewards.
[*]In the case of leaving and re-joining a clan, even if you participated in a Clan Match before leaving, if you do not participate in any Clan Matches [b]after[/b] re-joining you will not get any rewards.

[b]Bug Fixes and Improvements[/b][/list]
[*]Fixed an issue causing CTF mode to reward less GP than intended.
[*]An issue caused by using the "Repair All Equipment" function without sufficient GP, resulting in a negative GP balance, has been resolved.
[*]The location of the scope on the CheyTac's Cherry Blossom skin has been modified.
[*]Fixed a bug where using an emote while prone made the player unable to control the character. 
[*]Russian, Chinese, and Japanese fonts have been resized to fit into the UI.
[*]Fixed an issue causing the game to crash occasionally when joining a Clan Match as a Mercenary.
[*]Fixed a bug where the default scope was unable to be attached to the L96A1.
[*]The matchmaking system has been modified for players in a party.
[list]Currently, when players queue up as part of a party, their matching points are increased in order to compensate for the advantage of playing in a party.More specifically, matching points are calculated by taking into account a player's KDR, level, whether they are in a party and other factors.

Because of this, low level or average skilled players who queue up as a party are being placed with much higher skilled players and parties. This is the same reason for solo queue high level players finding themselves in teams of lower levelled players, making the games look unbalanced.

This update is removing the matching points increase players receive from being in a party. This should hopefully improve the situation and mean that lower skilled players find themselves in more balanced matches.[/list]

[*]Clan Match Season 2's 3rd rank clan 'InTeam's clan banner logo has been fixed.
[*]Ping displayed on Asia Servers now more accurately reflects actual ping.
[*]Server stabilization has been improved.[/*]
[/list]

notes.title: For Gamigo Players
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35212832/0bf148f7c1d26c3b573e71dfbed3178c3f42935d.png[/img]

Hi this is Ironsight team.

Foremostly, we want to thank to all of our fellow supporters and gamers of Ironsight, from the bottom of our hearts.							

In recent event with Gamigo, we have discussed how to continue our service in best way for fellow players without further inconvenience, after the service closure by Gamigo.

We concluded that it is not easy to transfer information due to several issues, which is different versions of the two servers, data protection laws under EU and impossible to transfer personal data to Steam because the steam account cannot verify personal information.

However, in order to be of any help to players who want to continue to play the game, we are going to give compensation for each level section through the procedure below.							
							
We tried out best to looking for transferring the data, but we are really apology that there's no applicable way to do.

To help our fellow gamers into a smooth transition to the new server, we would like to offer compensation based on levels.

It is our sincere hope that these compensations will help fellow Ironsight players to get back on tracks.							

[b]1. Target[/b][list]
: Players playing Gamigo Ironsight with an account of lv35 or higher[/list]

[b]2. How of apply[/b][list]
: Please read the procedure below carefully for apply[/list]
[list]1) Install Wiplegames Ironsight and create a callsign(IGN).[/list]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/783770/Ironsight/
[list]
2) Accessing to Gamigo version Ironsight and take screenshot of your in-game account info.							
[u](Do not change your screenshot file name)[/u]

3) Please find your screenshot from the screenshot folder and make sure you have proper screenshot.							

4) Please register your account information screenshot file and Wiplegames Ironsight callsign(IGN) 
you created on the application link below. 
- Do not fix your screenshot, and do not change your screenshot file name from how is saved. (If the file name is different, no compensation will be deliver.)

Application Link : [url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/1fJceeun9cCsVwsONAyHBaoCbumkNlVjW6Rwbm6cI3bo]Welcome package Application [/url]

5) If using public PC, please delete the screenshot after the registration.
[/list]
[b]3. Application Period[/b][list]
From Wiplegames maintenance on August 5th,2020 ~ September 30th, 2020
[u]*Not available to access to Wiplegames Ironsight before August 5th	[/u][/list]

[b]3. Date of deliver the compensation reward[/b][list]
: From August 20, 2020
 (1) Application applied before August 19 - All delivered on August 20
 (2) Application applied after August 19 - deliver on the following day (application applied on holiday (based on KST), rewards will deliver on the next business day).
[/list]

[b]4. Reward list[/b][list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35212832/e62f661f728cfd266b1c952f22273dfba5bf1203.png[/img]

[b][*]Over 250 level reward added (August 06, 2020 added) [/b]
Epic melee weapon is added to reward for over '250 level' players.
Delivery date : This will deliver after we check all application with Gamigo's DB.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35212832/605914aaf710d6c0302173b16843e27adecc420d.png[/img]


( We know the compensation reward is not enough for the players who have enjoyed the game for a long time. We wanted to give a meaningful gift in respect of the honor of the veteran players.

This weapon is [b]ONLY[/b] give to veteran players over 250 level players and this will not selling on the shop or rewards for the events. )


*Delivery date may different with Welcome Package reward delivery date.

[/list]
[b]5. Caution[/b][list]
* Rewards will be deliver only once per account. In case of duplicate application, it will be paid to the 
  account you applied for first.
* If you don't have a record of accessing the Wiplegames Ironsight, you can't get the rewards. You 
  must connect and create a callsign(IGN) on Wiplegames Ironsight.
* If you using other player's account information for application, you will be sanctioned.
* There will be no rewards for screenshots attached by other methods. ( e.g : cellphone, camera 
  captured screenshot is not acceptable )
* Applications without screenshots will not be rewarded	
[/list]

In addition, benefits for new players have been strengthened since July this year to make it easier to supply items and GP. For more information, please check the link below.

Check out additional rewads for new players benefits.
https://steamcommunity.com/games/783770/announcements/detail/2725193056662014945

Lastly, all employees of Wiplegames promise to do their best to continue the development of Ironsight and will also be informed of future operational plans as soon as possible.

Thank you.

notes.title: Team Battle Royal(Beta) Update Notice
notes.notes:
New special mode in Ironsight, Team Battle Royal!
Please check out Team Battle Royal rule and items!


[i]*The context could be changed as it is currently on Beta version.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35212832/9b9c49bae4bfcf0861cdadc962ceb36ac0a73a53.jpg[/img]
[b]Team Battle Royal[/b]
Objective : Eliminate all the enemies avoiding magnetic field.
Victory condition : Win 3 matches
Numbers of player : 4 to 12 players
Maps : Mart, Cruise, Haruyama
*Caution : The weapon EXP cannot be gained from Team Battle Royal Mode.


[b]Match Flow[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35212832/4bff889c054b173881363c9e1cb1f331c386b852.jpg[/img]
1. Players start with the main weapon and secondary weapon in the loadout. Only one ammo is provided for main weapon.
2. On the field, the ammo, ammo box, throwing weapons, syringe, healing grenade and etc are dropped randomly.
3. The farming bot is spawned in the middle of the map, and if it is destroyed, one of the drones will be available for looting.
4. The magnetic field will zoom in to the area which is shown on the minimap after 15 seconds standby time.
5. total 5 times of zooming in will proceed, and during the standby time, the area of zooming in and location will be marked.
6. Player HP regeneration will not be available, and if HP reaches 0, the player will turn into groggy status.
7. The player who is in groggy, they can be revived by the teammates with 'revive' function.
8. The team who stands in the end wins the round!

[b]Components[/b][list]
[*]Magnetic Field
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35212832/ab15dc4c1f03c095ebc3fec30ef612cce4220c6d.jpg[/img]
New magnetic fields are being spawned each round.
The magnetic fields will have total 5 times of zoom in and each time, it has 15 seconds of standby time.
If you enter the magnetic field area, you will receive 5 damage per second, and as long as it reaches to next magnetic field, the damage multiplies by 1.2 from former area damage.

[*]Groggy status
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35212832/9a52e960b289fc38b5f21037f4d51518c7cdb5a4.jpg[/img]
When player's HP reaches to 0, it will turn into groggy status.
The groggy player's view will turn to 3rd person's view.
Groggy player can slowly move around, be damaged by enemy players.
Groggy player can be revived by teammates.
- Player will revive with 30 HP.
If you are damaged by explosives(Drone, throwing weapons, and red can), you will be retired immediately without any groggy status.

[*]Farming Bot
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35212832/98527d56ecfb0ef0820b3a8cdc4f96ced1408aa8.jpg[/img]
Farming bot will be spawned in each center of the maps.
If you destroy farming bot, randomly, nothing will come out or one drone will come out.
if you get drone box, you should fill the point to use the drone. The points are differ to drones.
If you are killed, your weapons and drones will be dropped.
When the round is turned, you can still use the drones you got from former round.
Drone will be removed when you use it one time.
[/list]


[b]Drop items[/b][list]
Drop items will be dropped on the field as following.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35212832/187b78a7eadee7fbc84e74080eff04db5bc3b309.jpg[/img]


[*]Syringe
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35212832/b07758e7a4eb28febff4d069b5c8cff04525d153.jpg[/img]
Total 50HP will be recovered during 3 seconds after use.
You can cancel the motion to other while you use.
Total 2 syringe can be kept.

[*]Healing grenade
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35212832/61e08cf53b4553899c93929b8031b86c69b153a2.jpg[/img]
Healing 'all players' by 10 HP per sec for 15 seconds in 3M.

[*]Ammo, Ammo Box
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35212832/d0777ee184383a748b709725a56a9a0ad38bc71d.jpg[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35212832/a9939191286ed11213b9bb82bbeb6b26a65a9747.jpg[/img]
Ammo can be charged for one ammo for each weapons.
Ammo box fills all the ammo of the weapon.
[/list]

[h1]New Map: Station[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35212832/c1c2d9414c0202c33b46dbf589eabda8d3274380.jpg[/img]
Background story
Knowing that EDEN had been secretly supplying weapons to Anti-NAF organization, NAF plans to to act on by striking the heart of EDEN, Russia, the home of EDEN. Their targeted facility is Russia's proud railway facility, which, if successful, will directly impact EDEN, the owner of the facility, and leave deep fear throughout the continent

Landmark : Train Station in Russia, Rail, Platform
Weather Condition : Early winter day / snowy cold weather
Size : 115M x 82M (large)
Gameplay : Symmetrical, indoor, long distance
Theme : Industrial, City Center
Environment Interaction : Trains passing through every certain period of time and Elevator
Interactions : Trains, railways, platforms, elevators
 


Playable Game Mode
•	Capture The Flag
•	Team Death Match
•	Search And Destroy
•	Secure Point
•	Resource Takeover

Remark:
1. Matching Search
- Matching is performed in order from the region with the fastest response time(Ping).
- Users with longer matching times will have a slightly wider matching range.

2. Matching Balance
- You will be assigned a rating based on the latest grade, user level, and party status of the mode, and users with similar ratings will be matched.
- If you are in a party, you will be given an additional higher rating.
- The higher the level of party members, and the higher the number of members, the higher the matching rating.
- While performing team balancing, the rank of members assigned to the room will be taken into account .
- Except for Frontline Mode, game room of all other modes will be created with max. no. of players.

3. Team vacancy and entering existing room
- If a vacancy occurs during the room creation or game start process, or in a mode (front line) with a maximum number of 12 or more players, the vacancy will be replenished.
- 'Room Class' is assigned according to the room member's level, and the user who meets the corresponding level will be entered.

4. Standby time
- After the creation, the count down has been reduced from the existing 60 seconds to 30 seconds.

5. Max. no. of party member for normal matching changed
- Changed from 6 members to 3 members max.
- Max. no. of party member for Ranked is 6.

- Players will be penalized for leaving the game in ranking battle. (Unable to join ranked for certain period of time)
※ Definition of Leaving the Game
This is the act of leaving the ranking battle while it is in progress and not re-joining until end of the game
- Penalty for 'Inactive Act' in Ranking Battle is added
※ Definition of 'Inactive'
Applies to player with ELO points above 1200. If the player does not participate in ranking battle for 3 days, 5% of total point
will be deducted every 24 hours. Points will not get deducted below 1200 points and any player with the point below 1200
won't be affected by this penalty. Penalty notification will be displayed 24 hours prior to becoming inactive.

notes.title: New server added to SouthEast Asia!
notes.notes:
[h1]New server added to SouthEast Asia![/h1]


[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35212832/e5cfd173875cf0aaab5315bda29c9a916bd52e74.png[/img]


Traffic coming from SouthEast Asia has been increasing from the day of the pre-OBT release.

 Since it would be hard for us to provide optimal gaming environment to SEA users, we decided to add servers in SouthEast Asia region on June 28th.

 When players from SEA region starts the game using quick matching, depending on their network status, players will be sent to Asia server or to SEA server. 
This will be done automatically.


*Please note that custom game will have an improvement later.
We expect much more stable service to players in SouthEast Asia region.
We will continue to work hard to improve the service.
Thank you.
